form.label: Claude Enterprise - Governance
form.description: Directory membership, invitations, project and conversation activity, and agent lifecycle. Requires the Compliance Activity Feed input; directory panels also require the Compliance Directory Sync input.

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) AND actor_email!="null" | stats count by actor_email | sort actor_email

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) AND actor_email!="" AND actor_email!="null" | stats dc(actor_email) AS count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" (event_type=project_* OR event_type=conversation_* OR event_type=claude_chat_* OR event_type=claude_artifact_* OR event_type=platform_memory_*) $user_filter$ | stats count

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:user" (("$user$"="*") OR email_address="$user$") | sort - _time | dedup id | eval source_of_record="directory" | table email_address, name, role, status, id, source_of_record | append [ search `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ | eval email_address=coalesce(actor_email, entity_email, target_email) | where isnotnull(email_address) AND email_address!="" AND email_address!="null" | stats count latest(_time) AS last_seen by email_address | eval name=email_address, role="-", status="active", id=email_address, source_of_record="activity" | table email_address, name, role, status, id, source_of_record ] | sort source_of_record, email_address | dedup email_address
`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:group" | sort - _time | dedup id | table name, id, organization_id

panel.title: Directory sync is not collecting yet

html.p: The user/group roster panels read anthropic:compliance:user and anthropic:compliance:group, produced by the Compliance Directory Sync input. To enable them, go to Inputs > Create New Input > Compliance Directory Sync and select your account (interval 86400 recommended).

The input first tries the Compliance directory API; if your key cannot access it, it automatically falls back to the Anthropic Admin API (users, organization, workspaces) using your compliance or analytics key — a key with the read:members scope in either slot works. Errors are logged in index=_internal source=*anthropic_claude*.
Until directory data arrives, the Users table below is built from activity-feed emails only.

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" $user_filter$ event_type=org_user_invite_* | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_email, actor_user_id, organization_id | sort - _time

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" (event_type=project_* OR event_type=conversation_* OR event_type=claude_chat_* OR event_type=claude_artifact_* OR event_type=platform_memory_*) $user_filter$ | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_email, claude_project_id, claude_chat_id | sort - _time | head 50

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" event_type=*agent* $user_filter$ | `claude_actor_email` | table _time, event_type, actor_email, actor_ip_address, claude_project_id, organization_id | sort - _time | head 50
